name: Ralph Velador
office: Palmdale School District, Governing Board Member, Trustee Area No. 1

items.text: Ralph Velador is the board president and trustee for Area 1 of the Palmdale School District. He was appointed in February 2017 and elected to a four-year term in November 2018. He is a U.S. Army veteran, commander of American Legion Post 348, and director of organizing for LIUNA’s Pacific Southwest Regional Organizing Coalition.
